fallback: Zero correction relative to each method's own initialization. Coarse methods return to Coarse, not Official. Also record total displacement from Official.
primary_sampling: Exact historical A5000 inputs for real/BEHAVE; Native noisy cached depth/rays, deterministic hash sample up to5000 before GT evaluation. Same Native subset across seeds.
anchors: Original16384 face/barycentric; 256 subset from original linspace; visible256 mask fixed at original historical-Coarse replay, never updated during NN iterations.
projective_control: One step only. Keep original replayed ray residual as reference; matched comparison uses actual XYZ of the sampled cached lattice pixel versus Mesh-to-Obs NN on all valid XYZ of the SAME cached depth lattice, NOT historical raw A5000. Separately report query-ray versus sampled-pixel-ray reassignment difference.
plane_solver: Same Euclidean80% correspondence trimming; ordinary point-to-plane least squares using anchor normals; SVD pseudoinverse rcond1e-6, minimum-norm solution. No learned weights. Separate arm optionally applies existing normal eigenvalue attenuation lambda/(lambda+0.01).
aggregation: Per-frame metrics -> sequence means -> identity means -> identity-equal cohort mean. BEHAVE per-frame first averages K1/K2/K3 statistics. Each seed reported separately and mean/sample-SD.
evaluation: Historical exact point-to-triangle distance and fixed B points. Native corresponding vertices and camera parameter L2 from original GT, never used for fit. BEHAVE fitted-reference PVE supporting only.
primary_contrast: Coarse+historical median6 versus cached Full Last Fine and Official+historical Txyz. No winner selection or new training from B results.
precision: Historical official real fit uses float32 anchors; BEHAVE official uses float64 vertices as original evaluator. New Coarse primary follows each dataset's same anchor arithmetic. Shared source Body retained unchanged.
known_replay_boundary: One old BEHAVE seed23 frame failed strict replay visibility equality. Keep it in every metric and flag it in sparse/projection interpretation; dense primary does not depend on replay visibility.
TEST: No sealed Native/HuMMan TEST; BEHAVE is previously consumed official TEST subset.
scope: Diagnostic postprocessing only; does not redefine R5/R5.1 raw model main results or claim guaranteed accuracy, latency or novelty. Finite matched contrasts, not a full factorial or global causal attribution.
